verdict.rationale: Virtual machine creation is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. The pack's only related item is a bare help-guide heading, "Run Windows on your Mac" (macos-docs-18). It does not say this uses a built-in virtual machine, nor that VMs can be created and run quickly without manual configuration. That leaves the capability undocumented here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can quickly create and run virtual machines without manual configuration
